{{pkmn|Masters EX}} |trainer=[[Pokémon Trainer]] |counterpart=[[Trevor (Masters)]] |enva=Greg Vinciguerra[https://imgur.com/a/2Dzljun Email confirmation] ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |jpva=Sayaka Mori ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{castle color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon the Series]]'' |debut=''[[XY039|Summer of Discovery!]]'' |counterpart=[[Trevor (anime)]] |enva=[[Michael Lockwood Crouch]] |jpva=[[Minami Fujii]] }} {{Character Infobox/Manga |color={{castle color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Adventures]]'' |counterpart=[[Trevor (Adventures)]] |debut=''[[PS549|An X-cuse to Come Out and Play]]'' }} |} '''Trevor''' (Japanese: '''トロバ''' ''Trova'') is a [[friend]] and [[rival]] of the {{player}} in [[Pokémon X and Y]]. ==In the core series games== [[File:Friends XY.png|thumb|left|250px|Trevor with the player's other friends in Aquacorde Town]] Trevor appears in [[Pokémon X and Y]] as a friend of the player. Trevor delivers the player a [[Pokédex]] on behalf of [[Professor Sycamore]], and he aims to be the first among his friends to finish collecting data for his Pokédex. Trevor and his older sister live in [[Lumiose City]], near Jaune Plaza. Ever since their parents left them behind in order to travel around the world and train their Pokémon, it has been Trevor's dream to travel all over Kalos with a Pokédex of his own. He first battles the player on {{rt|7|Kalos}} alongside [[Tierno]]. From then on, Trevor occasionally engages in his own kind of battle with the player, comparing how much each has completed the Pokédex and losing every time. When the {{p|Abomasnow}} in [[Frost Cavern]] is threatened by [[Team Flare]], Trevor comes and helps the player by battling one Team Flare Grunt's Mightyena to let the player beat [[Mable]] and save the Abomasnow. After the player has entered the [[Hall of Fame]], Trevor can be found in [[Geosenge Town]]. There, he will tell the player about various Pokémon that can use [[Mega Evolution]]. Trevor captures many different kinds of Pokémon to complete his Pokédex, but the Pokémon he keeps in his party tend to be members of the [[Fairy (Egg Group)|Fairy Egg Group]] or ones revived from [[Fossil]]s. Trevor also appears as one of the player's partners in the [[Battle Maison]] when choosing Multi Battle. Trevor is mentioned by an NPC in {{g|Legends: Z-A}}, stating that he and Professor Sycamore are currently in another [[region]] together for research. ===Pokémon=== ====First battle ([[Multi Battle]] He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and [[Photography|photographer]] from [[Lumiose City]]. He debuted in ''[[XY039|Summer of Discovery!]]'' along with his friends {{an|Shauna}} and {{an|Tierno}}. ===GOTCHA!=== Trevor briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Trevor Adventures.png|thumb|130px|Trevor in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== {{main|Trevor (Adventures)}} In the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, Trevor is studying to become a scholar. Additionally, he is childhood friends with {{adv|X}}, {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}}, and serves as the narrator of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}. {{-}} ==In the TCG== [[File: TrevorXYPromo33.jpg|thumb|200px|Trevor]] {{main|Trevor (XY Promo 33)}} '''Trevor''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English XY Series (the Japanese XY Era). First released as an [[XY-P Promotional cards (TCG)|XY-P Promotional card]] in the Pokémon Card Gym Promotional Card Pack 3 from October to December 2014, the Trevor card debuted in English as an [[XY Black Star Promos (TCG)|XY Black Star Promo]] included in the {{TCG|Battle Arena Decks: Xerneas vs. Yveltal}}, with both prints featuring an illustration by Ken Sugimori. It was later reprinted with the same artwork in English in the {{TCG|XY Trainer Kit: Bisharp & Wigglytuff}}, and it saw two more releases as Japanese XY-P Promotional cards: First as a part of the Event Organizer Trainer's Pack in July 2016, and then in the CoroCoro Ichiban! Pokémon Card Game XY BREAK Victory Guide on July 28, 2016. This card allows the player to search their deck for any {{TCG|Pokémon}} and put it into their hand. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Trevor, along with [[Shauna]], battles the {{player}} less than any other [[rival]], only battling them twice throughout the entire game. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{castle color}}; border:3px solid #{{castle color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{castle color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{castle color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{castle color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | トロバ ''Trova'' | From ''trovato'' (Italian for "discovery")In the [[Pokémon X and Y]] website, Trevor is introduced as a boy who is "bursting with curiosity" ([https://www.pokemon.co.jp/ex/xy/character/02.html 好奇心旺盛な男の子]), corresponding to the theme of "discovery" in his name.
